name: can-a-foreigner-start-a-business-in-serbia
description: Can a foreign citizen start a business in Serbia, and should it be an entrepreneur (preduzetnik) or a limited liability company (DOO)? Covers, for 2026, the legal difference between the two forms under the Company Law (personal liability of the entrepreneur, limited liability of DOO members and its exceptions, the manager (poslovođa), the registered interruption of activity), the headline tax rates (10% on entrepreneur income, 15% corporate tax, 15% on dividends to individuals), the lump-sum (paušal) conditions including the RSD 6,000,000 turnover limit, the RSD 8,000,000 VAT registration threshold, and why registration does not give a right to live or work in Serbia (Visa D, single permit, temporary residence up to three years). Trigger on: foreigner business Serbia, DOO or preduzetnik, paušalac, strani državljanin firma Srbija.
